retroterm-ai.resumen: Retro-futuristic hub with a terminal look: AI assistant, code editor, games, articles and network tools.
descripcion: Retroterm-AI is a site with a CRT terminal look that brings several tools together in one place.

It includes ARIA, an AI assistant running on Cloudflare Workers and the Groq API with a Llama model; CODE_CRT, an in-browser code editor; a DeFi terminal; technical articles; network tools such as IP, binary and hex conversion or CIDR calculation; and a games section with Naval Strike and Wonder IV.
It has three colour themes (green, cyan and amber) that are remembered between visits.
retroterm-ai.problema: Bringing together useful tools for the IT field (networking, code and AI) in a single place, while also working as a personal website.
retroterm-ai.papel: Personal project, started in my first year of ASIR: full design and development.
datos_medidos: PageSpeed: 100 performance, 95 accessibility, 100 best practices and 100 SEO.
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit applied to 16 pages, with its fixes.

wonder-iv.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
wonder-iv.resumen: A match-three puzzle where you build the seven wonders of the ancient world: you break the ground under material blocks and workers carry them to the building site.
descripcion: A 7 × 7 board with seven carved-stone tiles and, among them, material blocks (stone, brick, marble, wood and bronze) that do not move: they drop when you clear the ground beneath them and workers carry them to the site.

Seven wonders, from the Great Pyramid to the Lighthouse of Alexandria, each with its own backdrop and difficulty, unlocked in order. The menu is your settlement: a map where the wonders you complete appear, plus five two-level buildings that you upgrade with the materials you collect and that give you advantages at the start of each build.

Special tiles, four limited-use powers, stars based on the moves you have left and a hint that marks the move clearing the most ground. The music is generative, one track per wonder and another for the village, with about thirty effects, all synthesised in the browser.
It works with a mouse and a touch screen, with no libraries and no third-party requests, and saves the record, stars, materials and buildings in the browser.
wonder-iv.papel: Personal project: game design, mechanics, generative music and development.
datos_medidos: An automated test in a real browser plays all seven wonders with a bot and checks the settlement, saving, bonuses, powers and that every track and effect plays.
pendiente: Tuning the balance of costs and bonuses: the current split is a first version.

ninja-de-escritorio.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
ninja-de-escritorio.resumen: A game of slicing retro computer icons with a Windows 95 style interface, for PC and mobile, with a nine-floor roguelike mode.
descripcion: Slice folders, floppy disks and CD-ROMs, dodge viruses and blue screens and beat malware bosses, in an interface inspired by Windows 95/98.

Descent mode: a nine-floor roguelike, one floor for each layer of the PC, with a wide-screen branching map, 23 upgrades and 6 synergies, 7 mutations, 8 relics, 6 wave anomalies, 12 events and a three-phase final boss. Each boss has its own mechanic, sounds and music.
A daily Descent with a fixed seed: the same map, offers, events and bosses for everyone that day, with a best result of the day and a day streak.

Each icon type has its own aura to tell at a glance what to slice and what not to. All the art is pixel art drawn by code in a single index.html with no libraries, played with a mouse or a finger, with mute (M), full screen (F) and respect for reduced motion.
ninja-de-escritorio.papel: Personal project: game design, code-generated pixel art and development.

kaiten.resumen: Installable web app to count sushi pieces: tap and it adds one.
descripcion: Touch counter with combos, pace and a personal record for nine piece types in three categories.
Stats with a seven-day chart, a meal history with place, duration and cost, reviews with photos and a map of your places built with OpenFreeMap and MapLibre.
Achievements, daily challenges and colour themes. On a computer, from 1000 px, it shows a live panel next to the counter.
It works offline, installs as an app and keeps everything on the device: no accounts, no server and no tracking.
kaiten.problema: Keeping track of what you eat at a conveyor-belt sushi restaurant, and what it costs, without signing up for anything and without a connection.
kaiten.papel: Personal project: design, SVG illustrations and development in a single file.

hilo-cortado.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
hilo-cortado.resumen: Side-scrolling beat 'em up for one or two players with wooden puppets: every hit spends a string.
descripcion: Each puppet hangs from five strings. Cut the arm strings and the enemy drops its weapon; cut the head string and it collapses into a heap of planks. The strings are both life and weapon, and bosses lose attacks as they lose strings.

Ten characters articulated from illustrated parts on a single skeleton, so cut strings, dangling limbs and bodies falling apart into pieces keep working. Three acts with illustrated backdrops, three bosses, weapons you pick up and break, and different music in each act.

Local co-op for two, with keyboard, gamepad or touch screen, three difficulty levels and best scores saved per difficulty and number of players. One code file using Canvas 2D and Web Audio plus an image folder: if an image is missing, that part is drawn by code.
hilo-cortado.papel: Personal project: game design, puppet animation, generative music and development.
datos_medidos: Automated tests with Playwright: 21 mechanics tests, 21 difficulty and saving checks, 6 full playthroughs of the three acts with bots and 40 one-minute fights with the five enemy types.
pendiente: Testing the difficulty balance with players: so far only bots have tried it.

dead-heat.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
dead-heat.resumen: A maze of embers where you change the route: heat melts the ice, opens shortcuts and releases water against the enemies.
descripcion: You are a small flame in an ice maze. The embers you collect charge heat, and heat melts walls, opens shortcuts and releases water that spreads through the corridors, slows enemies down and can evaporate them.

Three modes with their own levels and seeded mazes: Thaw, the original; Classic, an eat-and-dodge maze with ghosts of different personalities (chaser, ambusher, shy and wanderer); and Bombs, with ice blocks broken by heat bombs in a cross shape and in chains.
Three difficulty levels (Easy, Normal and Hard) with a record saved per mode and difficulty. Keyboard, gamepad and touch screen, full screen and reduced motion if the system asks for it.
Pixel art drawn by code, and layered sound and music synthesised with Web Audio. The game is a single index.html generated from src/, with no dependencies.
dead-heat.papel: Personal project: game design, code-drawn graphics, sound and development.
datos_medidos: Automated tests in Node and Chromium: 4,200 generated mazes without a single isolated floor tile and 30 full games with a bot, of which it finished 22.
pendiente: Checking real feel and difficulty with people, and how the audio sounds: bots do not play like a person.

panal-roto.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
panal-roto.resumen: A falling-piece puzzle on a hexagonal board, with lines in three directions and chain collapses.
descripcion: A honeycomb of 9 columns by 16 rows and the ten possible shapes made of four hexagons. Lines close in a zigzag and along both diagonals, and crossing them multiplies the score.
After each clear, what is left collapses like rigid bodies: if the fall completes another line, it clears by itself and a chain begins.

Three modes: Marathon (150 lines), Time Attack (3 minutes) and Daily Game (80 lines with the same pieces for everyone that day). Hold slot, a queue of five pieces, an optional ghost piece and DAS and ARR settings.

A colour-blind mode with a different engraved pattern on each piece, reduced motion, and menus with keyboard and screen-reader announcements. Keyboard, gamepad and touch, in a single index.html using Canvas and Web Audio, with no dependencies.
panal-roto.papel: Personal project: game design and development.
datos_medidos: Automated tests: 94 rules checks, 30 in a real browser and over 3,000 seeded bot games, checking the board invariants at every step; median frame time of 16.7 ms.
pendiente: A thorough review of the game: it may change.

caja-de-arena.licencia: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free to use, study, modify and share for non-commercial purposes.
caja-de-arena.resumen: Particle simulator in the browser: sand, water, fire, gunpowder, acid, plants and lava reacting to each other.
descripcion: A grid of 384 × 256 cells where each cell holds a material and decides what to do based on its neighbours: sand falls, water spreads, fire sets wood alight.

Ten tools (sand, water, wall, wood, fire, gunpowder, acid, plant, lava and eraser) and three materials that appear on their own: smoke, steam and stone. On opening there is already a prepared scene, with a sand mountain, a pond with plants, a ledge of lava, a glass of acid and a wooden tower with gunpowder inside.

A brush in three sizes, pause, three speeds and keyboard shortcuts. A single index.html with Canvas 2D, no libraries, no network and no saving: what you draw disappears when you close the tab. Mouse, keyboard and touch screen.

lorekeeper.resumen: Serverless, portable reading tracker with 3D books, a timer, stats and optional achievements.
descripcion: A reading timer that keeps counting with the app closed, audiobooks included, and 3D books in the colour of their cover.
A library with shelves, series and loans; search in Google Books, Open Library and Apple Books, an ISBN scanner and import from CSV or Excel.
Stats, a yearly summary, 24 achievements and optional levels, and six visual styles. It even works by double-clicking the file, and keeps everything on the device.
lorekeeper.papel: Personal project: design and development in plain JavaScript and CSS.

hemiciclo.resumen: General election night simulator: a real map of the provinces and a 350-seat Congress filling up live.
descripcion: Animated vote count across the 52 constituencies with their real shapes, seat allocation with D'Hondt and a breaking-news column with swings and key seats.
Scenarios with probabilities calculated from 400 Monte Carlo simulations, live coalitions, a coalition builder and a historical mode from 1977 to 2023.
It is built from src/ into a single index.html, with automated tests and screenshots at 1440 and 390 px that check nothing overflows. It is the base of a political strategy game in the works.
hemiciclo.papel: Personal project: design, election engine and interface.
alts: Hemiciclo on election night: map of provinces and Congress filling up seat by seat.
Coalitions panel with the possible deals and the coalition builder.
Historical mode with results from 1977 to 2023.

inventario-vinilos.resumen: Web app to catalogue a record collection, published on GitHub Pages.
descripcion: Shelves with records in a carousel, a table view exportable to Excel and stats by genre, decade, artist and format.
When you add a record it queries MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive to fill in year, genre and cover; it also accepts a photo taken with your phone.
Sync between devices encrypted on the device itself, through a Cloudflare Worker that cannot read the data, automatic backups and tests in a real browser before every release.
inventario-vinilos.problema: Cataloguing a large record collection without losing a single one: version 2 was rebuilt inside so that a browser glitch can never empty the collection.
inventario-vinilos.papel: Personal project: design, development and sync server.

impronta.resumen: Hand-made website for a fictional print shop, built during my work placement, with a WordPress version, a process dossier and a weekly log.
descripcion: Corporate website for a fictional print shop in Madrid, with eleven pages: home with video, services catalogue, history and team, a blog with three articles, contact, legal pages and a custom error page.
It includes a business card generator that draws the card in real time in three styles and downloads the front and back as PNG.

On my own initiative, beyond what the brief required: CSS variables, fluid typography with clamp(), a theme saved in the browser, a step-by-step form more complete than required, a cookie panel with categories and Open Graph metadata.
The project was also delivered as a WordPress version, together with a process dossier and a weekly log.
impronta.papel: End-of-year project of my first year of ASIR, built during my work placement (FCT) for the Markup Languages module: full design and development.

nexus.resumen: Themed social network built from scratch in PHP and MySQL, connecting people through their taste in music and video games.
descripcion: Sign-up with bcrypt-hashed passwords and PHP sessions, a feed of posts with votes and replies, and profiles with avatar, bio and status.
An affinity engine matches your tastes with everyone else's and ranks users by compatibility percentage, showing the tastes you share.
A MySQL database with users, tastes, posts, connections and votes; the profile is saved with fetch without reloading the page.
nexus.papel: Personal project from my first year of ASIR: full design, database and development.
alts: NEXUS home page: community search with filters for music, gaming, metal and other genres.

project-dossier.resumen: Static case archive with a D3 connections map and internal editing tools.

Each file is based on public domain or already published documents; the project does not claim that the theories it collects are true.

pokemon-bash-simulator.resumen: Turn-based battle simulator written in Bash, where every creature is a Linux user.
descripcion: Every creature is a real system user created with useradd, types are Linux groups and stats live in files inside their home folder. The loser is removed with userdel -r and a “centre” script restores them all.
It grew over three versions: turn-based combat with critical hits and speed; multiple types and a special attack; and the final version.
pokemon-bash-simulator.papel: Linux system administration project from my first year of ASIR.

retroamp.resumen: Retro music player with custom skins, installable as an app on your phone.
descripcion: An in-browser player with a 90s look and skins that can be exported and imported as JSON.
It loads your own MP3 files, generates a vinyl cover for each song with Canvas and plays them with the Web Audio API.
